caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jar positioned upright and centered on a plain, unadorned background. The jar is cylindrical in shape with slightly sloping shoulders, a narrow neck, and a flared lip at the opening. Its main color is a natural beige or light brown, with visible shading and textural details giving the appearance of stoneware. On the upper section of the jar, there are several brushstrokes in a deep blue color forming simple, loose decorative patterns that include curved lines and elongated shapes. The background is an off-white or cream color, and there are no other objects present in the composition. A faint handwritten signature appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Vase
